title: Cholesterol-dependent ST depression does not establish incremental cross-hospital angiographic CAD prediction
abstract: A cholesterol-by-exercise-ST-depression term did not establish incremental angiographic CAD prediction: Cleveland cross-validated Brier gain -0.002185; independent-institution Hungarian gain 0.001286 (500 joint source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.010506, 0.007040]). Flexible additive routine predictors were compared with the same ridge logistic model plus one prespecified product. Source n=303; target n=261/294 records. The slight external gain reversed under linear and richer spline baselines. Distinct institutional cohorts provide a retrospective external test, not pristine prospective confirmation. This negative result does not establish physiological equivalence.
